etapes.fr: E-mail formel : Dear Mr Koné, / Dear Sir or Madam, … Yours sincerely / Best regards. E-mail informel : Hi Awa, … See you soon / Love.
etapes.en: Choose the right register: formal for work, informal for friends.

etapes.fr: Phrases utiles (formel) : I am writing to… / Please find attached… / I look forward to hearing from you.
etapes.en: These phrases make you sound professional.

exemples.en: I am writing to apply for the position of…
exemples.fr: Je vous écris pour postuler au poste de…

exemples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

etapes.en:
Dear Mrs Bamba,
I am writing to confirm my appointment on Monday at 10 am. Please find attached the documents you requested.
I look forward to meeting you.
Best regards,
Awa Traoré
I look forward to hearing from you

etapes.fr: Je vous écris concernant votre annonce.
reponses: I am writing regarding your advertisement.
I am writing about your advertisement.
I am writing regarding your ad.

etapes.en: Could you confirm that you are available?
choix: Pourriez-vous confirmer que vous êtes disponible ?
Pourriez-vous dire si vous êtes intéressé ?

etapes.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to ask for information about your courses.
etapes.fr: Madame, Monsieur, je vous écris pour demander des informations sur vos cours.

resume: Formal: Dear Mr…, I am writing to…, Please find attached…, I look forward to hearing from you, Yours sincerely / Best regards.
devoir: Write a formal email to ask for an internship (8 lines).
